sourcePolicy: Manufacturer-published CAD and documentation only, vendored with provenance. Every file must declare sourceUnit and sourceUpAxis, established from a dimensioned source rather than assumed. See viewer/public/models/PROVENANCE.md.

families.title: Kohler DTV+ Digital Shower
families.description: Kohler's digital shower platform: a wall-mounted user interface driving a networked valve controller. This family is the subject of an open repair and modification investigation.

parts.title: Digital Interface (wall control unit)
parts.description: The wall-mounted control the user actually touches. Manufacturer CAD, exported from 3ds Max in 2014 and published by Kohler as part of the K-99693 specification package.
parts.modNotes: AS PUBLISHED THIS MESH IS NOT WATERTIGHT: 222 boundary edges across 11 open loops, plus 2 hairline non-manifold T-junction seams. The viewer's repair pass closes all of it — welds 11,242 duplicate vertices, caps all 11 loops with 200 triangles, collapses the 2 seams — and the outer envelope does not move by so much as 0.0001 mm. Download the repaired mesh for Fusion 360, CAM or slicing; download as-published only if you want Kohler's bytes unaltered. HOLLOW SHELL, NO INTERNALS: enclosed volume after capping is 190.30 cm3 against a 346 cm3 bounding box, and there is no geometry between the front bezel and the rear plate. This is a visualization model — it does NOT contain the PCB, the wire-to-board connector, internal ribs or bosses. Do not treat it as authority for what is safe to cut into. Envelope measures 133.59 x 30.84 x 84.07 mm, agreeing with the spec sheet to 0.24 mm on width and 0.07 mm on height. Depth reads 0.68 mm over the published 1-3/16 in, plausibly a trim-ring detail excluded from the published figure — NOT checked against the physical part. The CAD is also a single unnamed group with no materials and no UVs, so buttons, display window and bezel are not separable without splitting the mesh by hand.

files.name: 99693-P.obj
files.provenanceNote: Units and axes VERIFIED, not assumed. The mesh bounding box is 5.259 x 1.214 x 3.310 along X/Y/Z. The K-99693 spec sheet gives 5-1/4 in wide by 3-5/16 in high by 1-3/16 in deep. Width maps to X (5.259 vs 5.250) and height to Z (3.310 vs 3.3125), so the file is in inches with Z as the up axis and Y as depth. Reading it as millimetres would make the part 5 mm wide.
